## Summary

Describe the problem, proposed change and affected host versions.

## Validation

List the commands and environments you used, their results and any checks still outstanding. For vendoring changes, include the exact engine commit and parity evidence. For packaging changes, describe the installed artefact you tested.

## Compatibility and recovery

Explain any change to supported hosts, public interfaces or package contents. Describe how to revert the change. Keep credentials, private host artefacts and unsanitised session logs out of the pull request.
